# Decoder provenance

vendor/ooz.abi3.so matches the binary inside the owner-supplied pyooz 0.0.8 manylinux_2_17_x86_64 wheel. The upstream 0.0.8 source distribution is retained here with SHA-256 in provenance.json, alongside upstream wheel metadata for the planned Windows/Linux dependency loader.

Source archive is downloaded from PyPI and hash-checked. It is upstream source provenance, not evidence of a locally reproduced byte-identical native build. B01 must record the actual build dependencies and packaged license/source materials. Windows wheel availability does not imply Windows runtime validation.
